summary: Comprehensive testing of Cigarothèque features including Catalogue filters, pagination, Edit modal (admin), Apéro du Club, and Ma Cigarthèque (member). All backend APIs and frontend features working correctly.
test_credentials: No authentication required - Development mode (accès libre). Default user: Fabien Lanfranchi (admin/président)
seed_data_creation: Test cigares created and cleaned up during backend testing. Existing data in Ma Cigarthèque: 2 cigares. Existing data in Apéro du Club: 1 cigare.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Cigarothèque page refactoring complete. All features tested and working correctly.

GET /api/cigares.details: Returns paginated list with 657 cigares total

GET /api/cigares-filtres.details: Returns all filter options: marques, pays, puissances, vitoles

PUT /api/cigares/{id}.details: Update cigare fields in MySQL works correctly

Edit Modal UI.details: Modal opens with all fields: Marque, Gamme, Vitole, Pays, Puissance (dropdown), Prix, Note, Conclusion, Save/Cancel buttons

GET /api/apero-club.details: Returns list of cigares fumés (1 item in test data)

POST /api/apero-club.details: Add cigare to Apéro du Club works correctly

DELETE /api/apero-club/{id}.details: Delete cigare from Apéro du Club works correctly

Apéro du Club Tab UI.details: Shows list with Copy and Delete (admin) buttons

GET /api/ma-cigarotheque/{membre_id}.details: Returns personal collection (2 items in test data)

POST /api/ma-cigarotheque.details: Add cigare to personal collection works correctly

PUT /api/ma-cigarotheque/{cigare_id}.details: Update note and comment works correctly

DELETE /api/ma-cigarotheque/{cigare_id}.details: Delete from personal collection works correctly

Ma Cigarthèque Tab UI.details: Shows personal collection with Edit, Copy, Delete buttons. Importer and Fiche vierge buttons visible.

Admin View.details: Admin sees 2 tabs: Catalogue + Apéro du Club (no Ma Cigarthèque)

Member View.details: Member sees 3 tabs: Catalogue + Apéro du Club + Ma Cigarthèque

pagination.details: Pagination works correctly with next/prev buttons, 20 items per page
